verdict.rationale: Requesty's core inference surface (chat completions, images, PDFs, web search, reasoning, structured outputs, MCP gateway) is fully API-driven and documented, but many UI-configured features are only described as dashboard/settings features with no documented management API, and a direct probe for an OpenAPI/swagger spec returned 404 on all candidate paths, suggesting no comprehensive programmatic control-plane API. missing for 10: documented API/CLI endpoints for configuring fallback/load-balancing policies, guardrails, service accounts, spend caps, and prompt-library management; an accessible OpenAPI spec confirming full UI-parity via API.
